title: Policy
description: Operator-tunable parameters governing the cadence enforcer. Loaded from ${SOX_CONFIG_DIR}/policy.toml if present, falling back to the defaults specified here. Defined in CONTRACTS.md §4.

schema_version.description: Protocol schema version. MUST be '1.0' for this revision.

reminder_threshold_tool_calls.description: Number of tool calls (tool_used events) since last drain after which a reminder injection is triggered.

reminder_threshold_turns.description: Number of LLM turns (turn_started events) since last drain after which a reminder injection is triggered.

force_drain_on_stop.description: When true, a stop_requested event while the agent's inbox is non-empty produces a 'block' decision requiring the agent to drain before exiting.

send_followed_by_idle_turns.description: Number of turns after a channels__send with no subsequent channels__recv that triggers a send-and-wait anti-pattern warning.

suspect_send_and_wait.description: When true, enables the send-and-wait anti-pattern detection governed by send_followed_by_idle_turns.

reminder_text_drain.default: You have not checked the channels inbox in a while. Call {{recv_tool}} before continuing if you may be waiting on input.
reminder_text_drain.description: Injected message when tool_calls_since_drain or turns_since_last_drain crosses its threshold. MUST use {{recv_tool}} placeholder rather than a concrete tool name.

reminder_text_drain_on_stop.default: Inbox not drained. Call {{recv_tool}} and integrate any messages before completing the task.
reminder_text_drain_on_stop.description: Block message produced on stop_requested when inbox is non-empty and force_drain_on_stop is true. MUST use {{recv_tool}} placeholder rather than a concrete tool name.

reminder_text_send_and_wait.default: You sent a message and have not made progress. Per the discipline, continue under your best-guess interpretation while awaiting reply. Drain the inbox at the next major decision.
reminder_text_send_and_wait.description: Injected message when the send-and-wait anti-pattern is detected. MUST use placeholder tokens rather than concrete tool names where tool references are needed.

examples.reminder_text_drain: You have not checked the channels inbox in a while. Call {{recv_tool}} before continuing if you may be waiting on input.
examples.reminder_text_drain_on_stop: Inbox not drained. Call {{recv_tool}} and integrate any messages before completing the task.
examples.reminder_text_send_and_wait: You sent a message and have not made progress. Per the discipline, continue under your best-guess interpretation while awaiting reply. Drain the inbox at the next major decision.
Continue working under best-guess; drain inbox at next checkpoint.
